about.title: Built for Safety, Longevity, and Peace of Mind
about.paragraph: Jennings Dock Services specializes in galvanized steel boat docks, professional boat lifts and lift repair, wood and steel dock repair, scuba diving, anchor & cable work. As a family-owned business with 25+ years of experience, we focus on durable, high-quality work that guarantees safety and longevity for your waterfront assets. Trust us for expert service in marine and dock projects.

services.title: Galvanized Steel Docks
services.description: Custom fabrication, installation, and modification of heavy-duty galvanized steel docks.

services.title: Boat Lifts & Lift Repair
services.description: Installation, preventative servicing, cable replacements, and motor repairs for all major residential and commercial boat lift systems.

services.title: Dock Repair & Maintenance
services.description: Comprehensive structural restoration for both wood and steel docks, including decking replacement, flotation repair, and hinge re-welding.

services.title: Anchor & Cable Work
services.description: Heavy-duty anchoring, winch installations, cable tightening, and seasonal dock adjustments to keep your dock secure year-round.

services.title: Scuba Diving & Underwater Recovery
services.description: Professional underwater inspections, submerged debris clearing, dropped item recovery, and underwater structural assessments.
